senses.gloss: to scrape, sharpen, grind.—Part. pass. חָרוּף, f. חֲרוּפָה, pl. חֲרוּפוֹת.
units: Pesik. R. s. 21 פנים ח׳ sharp (severe) countenance (Var. הדופות).—Trnsf. to deflour, v. infra.

senses.gloss: (cmp. חלף) to change, transform; to change possession. Part. pass. f. חֲרוּפָה designated for change of condition, v. חֲרוּפָה.
(of grist) to be ground; trnsf. to be defloured, have intercourse. Y. Kidd. I, 59ᵃ top (expl.
units: Lev. XIX, 20) נֶחֱרֶפֶת … בכתושה לפני איש ‘neḥĕrefeth by a man’ means crushed before a man (with ref. to Prov. XXVII, 22, v. הֲרִיפוֹת).

Kerith. 11ᵃ (ref. to נחרפת explained by בְּעוּלָה) מאי משמע … דשנויי הוא (Rashi: דשינויא) what proof is there that neḥĕrefeth has the meaning of change from natural condition? Answ. ref. to הָרִיפוֹת (II Sam. XVII, 19) and to Prov. l. c.

senses.gloss: (cmp. גָּרַף, גָּדַף) [to scrape off,] to revile, blaspheme, shame.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 7">Lev. R. s. 7</cite>, end <he>מְחָרֶפֶת ומגדפת</he> she (Rome) blasphemes and reviles.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:2">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <he>מְחָרְפָם</he>, v. <cite ref="C00237"><he>גָּדַף</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 94a">Snh. 94ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>שחי׳ ע״י וכ׳</he> who blasphemed (the Lord) through a messenger; a. fr.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 74:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIV</cite>, end <he>שמִתְחָרֵף ומתנאץ</he> which is reviled and blasphemed.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 1</cite> <he>עד שנִתְחָרַפְתִּי</he> until I was reviled; a. e.
<cite ref="Genesis 12">B’resh. 12</cite> (play on <he>קיץ וחרף</he>) <he>שתהיו מתקייצין ופניכם מִתְחָרְפִין</he> (some ed. <he>מתחפרין</he>) that you will feel nauseous and your faces become pale.
